name: cooking-cajun_creole
description: Recipe hypergraph from Cajun/Creole cuisine (the United States (Cajun/Creole, Louisiana)). Nodes represent ingredients. Each hyperedge represents a recipe and contains the set of ingredients used in that recipe.

hypergraph_metadata.name: (STRING) Dataset name (e.g., cooking-cajun_creole).
hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.name: (STRING) Name of the food ingredient (e.g., herbs).
